goal: Perform a full visual redesign of the existing Next.js app to achieve a premium dark-mode SaaS aesthetic
completed_steps: Loaded and analyzed mandatory frontend, design-taste, high-end design, and motion performance skills.
Searched and established the authoritative premium dark-mode SaaS design system matching the fallback token palette rules.
Audited the codebase typography, color leaks, and layout patterns.
Formulated and outputted a comprehensive, grouped written plan before editing any files.
Swapped fonts to Geist Sans + Geist Mono and defined deep space CSS variables inside `app/globals.css`.
Engineered a unified, single source of truth `<StatusBadge>` primitive using Phosphor icons.
Created a high-end, spring-animated sliding panel `<FormShell>` right-edge drawer primitive.

Restyled stats KPI dashboards into clean cards with precise monospace layout numbers.

Overrode FullCalendar with professional dark theme colors, styled event elements, and popover detail overlays.
Restructured `CommitmentList` rows separated by dark hairlines, equipped with hover haptic effects and status badges.
Polished empty states, the ErrorBoundary alert layout, and the landing page grid.
Verified clean compilation with zero ESLint/TypeScript/Next.js warnings or build errors.
